description: Hand-written spoken-style passages in French, German, Spanish and Portuguese with reference punctuation, mirroring the categories of synthetic.gold.json (meeting, question, numbers with decimal commas, stream, lecture, short turn, support call, casual, question chain, long single sentence). No abbreviations. Spanish keeps its inverted marks, which inputs strip and the scorer ignores.
